entities.summary: Visual arts education is the area of learning that is based upon visual art forms such as—drawing, painting, sculpture, printmaking. Within these forms of art may be designs in jewelry, pottery, weaving, fabrics, and design applied to more practical fields such as commercial graphics and home furnishings. Contemporary topics include photography, video, film, design, and computer art.
